en: A colorized panoramic view over the city of Graz, showing dense historic buildings with red and brown roofs surrounded by green hills. In the left foreground stands a prominent tower with a steep, reddish roof, rising above trees—this is the famous clock tower on the Schlossberg hill. Below the image, there is printed German text and a handwritten message in purple ink along the lower margin.
